name: get_quote
description: READ-ONLY fare quote WITH signed quote token (V0.3 contract). Computes the deterministic fare from the official pricing grid (pricing_zones) and returns {status, fare, currency, zone_code, quote_token, expires_at}. AIRPORT PRICING IS BY GEOGRAPHIC ZONE: ZONE_1 = $35 flat, ZONE_2 = $45 flat, ZONE_3 = $15 + $2.75/mile; medical = $20 + $2.75/mile. The zone is determined by the server from the city of the non-airport address; if it cannot be determined, the result is {status: 'ZONE_REQUIRED'} and NO fare: ask the caller for the city and call again. The quote_token is an HMAC-signed token binding service type, addresses, pickup time, zone, distance and fare; it is valid 15 minutes, is REQUIRED by create_booking_commit, and can be consumed exactly once. Creates nothing, books nothing, never alerts a driver. Call this BEFORE quoting any price. RESPONSE CONTRACT: this tool is called through the assistant server URL; the server (Make scenario W02, 6825545) answers HTTP 200. ENVELOPE UNVERIFIED: confirm from a dashboard test call whether Vapi sends a toolCallList envelope or a flat JSON body; W02 was verified with a flat body. If the distance cannot be measured, result contains {status: 'DISTANCE_REQUIRED'} and NO fare: ask the caller for the approximate distance and call get_quote again with caller_stated_distance_miles, or state that the fare will be confirmed by the driver. Never invent a fare.

caller_stated_distance_miles.description: Approximate distance in miles stated by the caller. Provide ONLY when the server answered DISTANCE_REQUIRED on a previous call and the caller gave an approximate distance.

dropoff_address.description: Full dropoff address as given by the caller.

pickup_address.description: Full pickup address as given by the caller.

pickup_datetime.description: Requested pickup date and time, ISO 8601 (America/New_York).

service_type.description: The ride type identified during the call.

zone_code.description: Airport zone if you already know it from a previous get_quote answer in this call (ZONE_1, ZONE_2 or ZONE_3). Usually omit: the server determines it from the city.

version: pin the version at creation (do NOT leave 'use latest version')
notes: Header value is a PLACEHOLDER: the shared secret is unchosen. The same value must later be set in the Make gate filters (W1 v3 + W02). Until then the gate rejects everything: fail-closed.
Envelope shape (toolCallList vs flat JSON) is UNVERIFIED: W02/W1 v3 were verified with flat JSON bodies. Establish from a Vapi dashboard test call in the new account before going live; do not assume.
